errors.text: The proposed Lindemann-criterion workflow does not provide a rigorous calculation of entropy of fusion or heat capacity; these require free-energy or enthalpy derivatives and explicit solid–liquid free-energy comparison.
It omits the central replacement of thermodynamic integration by free-energy perturbation and does not exploit the small MTP–DFT energy-difference variance that enables rapid convergence.
The cited evidence concerns mechanical deformation, irradiation resistance, and oxidation rather than melting free energies or validation of the proposed lattice-distortion correction.
The numerical accuracy claims of ±50 K and improvement over CALPHAD by more than 100 K have no supporting evidence.
